Brave 独立索引（不是 Google/Bing 的转售），按次计费，免费档对: Brave's own independent index (not a resale of Google/Bing results), billed per call; the free tier is enough for individuals and small teams.
发一次最小搜索验证凭证是否可用（会消耗 1 次搜索配额）: Runs one minimal search to verify the credential works (consumes 1 search quota)
如 cn / us；留空用上游默认: e.g. cn / us; leave empty to use the upstream default
如 zh-CN / en；留空用上游默认: e.g. zh-CN / en; leave empty to use the upstream default
按关键词搜索网页，返回标题/链接/摘要的列表: Search the web by keyword and return a list of titles/links/snippets
要搜索的关键词或问题: The keyword or question to search for
部分上游会给一段现成答案（Tavily / DuckDuckGo 摘要）；没有则: Some upstreams return a ready-made answer (Tavily / DuckDuckGo summary); otherwise this is empty — the first result is never used as a stand-in
默认 8，上限 20（Google 单次最多 10 条）: Default 8, maximum 20 (Google returns at most 10 per call)
